text: In the PURE system, non-natural amino acids can be incorporated by introducing an orthogonal aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase/tRNA pair that suppresses the amber (UAG) stop codon.
explanation: This is true and matches the chapter's description of non-natural amino acid incorporation: an orthogonal aaRS/tRNA pair reads through the UAG amber codon, allowing incorporation of amino acids bearing azide groups, fluorescent labels, or crosslinkers for genetic code expansion.
